verdict.rationale: Trello documents its own card-relationship features, 'Link cards' and 'Card mirroring', plus a Jira-in-a-list view. These could relate and surface work across teams' boards, and Trello markets cross-team collaboration. However, nothing documents explicit dependency tracking such as blockers or dependency views. Missing for 10: explicit dependency/blocker relationships, cross-board dependency visualization (e.g., timeline or roadmap of dependencies), launch-level coordination views, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
